newsitem.title: GERMANY: D.Telekom, Intel in video pact.
newsitem.headline: D.Telekom, Intel in video pact.

text.p: German telephone company Deutsche Telekom AG said on Thursday it would begin offering a video conferencing package based on computer chip maker Intel Corp.'s ProShare software.

Business Video Conferencing, due to hit the German market in July, includes ProShare, which runs on personal computers, along with a new decoder for Telekom's T-Online service and a file transfer program for digital ISDN phone lines.

The package would let PCs transmit video, images computer files and audio over phone lines to other PCs with similar equipment. Business Video Conferencing conforms to standards that would let it communicate with other conferencing systems.
The product would sell for 1,380 marks, Telekom said.
Telekom and Intel also agreed to work together to develop other multimedia products.
